description: Leo HR helps employers manage everyday HR administration directly from ChatGPT. Access approved company and employee information, identify items needing attention, and support routine workforce tasks using information held securely in your Leo HR account. Leo respects role-based permissions and keeps employers in control of sensitive or significant actions.

defaultPrompt: What HR tasks need my attention?
